d.t: Heavy duty, highly flexible, water based bitumen waterproofing membrane
d.s: Sika Tite BE is a heavy duty, highly flexible, water based bitumen waterproofing membrane. Sika Tite BE is suitable for permanent immersion and provides excellent adhesion to a wide range of substrates.Sika Tite BE is fast drying, easy to apply and is designed for non-UV exposed applications.
us: Repairs on existing bitumen surfaces and membranes (Non-UV exposed)

sec.t: AS/NZS 4020 : 2018 Products for use in contact with drinking water
12 months from date of manufacture in original, sealed containers, if the storage conditions are met.
Store in dry, weatherproof environment, protected from direct sunlight at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C.
Sika Tite BE can be applied to the following substrates: Concrete Masonry Sand/cement screeds Fibrous cement sheeting Compressed fibrous cement sheeting Steel/Aluminium Timber posts
Sika Tite BE must be cured for at least 48 hours at 23°C (longer at lower temperatures.) Sika Tite BE must be cured for a minimum 3 days before coming in contact with water or any form of backfill.
Allow minimum 2 - 4 hours between coats at 23°C. Allow longer in adverse weather conditions. Drying time is dependent on ambient temperature and relative humidity.
1.0mm DFT- (Dry Film thickness): 7.5m2 per 15L pail 2m2 per 4L pail

All surfaces to be waterproofed must be firm, clean, dry, structurally sound and smooth. All grease, oil, wax, curing compounds, dust, loose material, laitance and other contaminants must be removed. The substrate surface must be continuous, all projections and rough spots should be dressed off to achieve a level surface. Sika Tite BE can be mixed with sand and cement or pre-bagged mortar mix to form a screed to falls or patching render with improved adhesion and tensile properties. Sheeting Fibrous cement sheeting must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's installation directions. Concrete Concrete must be allowed to cure for 28 days and cement render and sand and cement screeds must be allowed to cure for 7 days prior to the application. Surfaces must be even and smooth, imperfections repaired with a suitable Sika MonoTop repair mortar. Priming Dry porous substrates must be primed using a dilute 1 part Sika Tite BE to 3 parts water, work well into the substrate to ensure adequate penetration, avoid ponding. Allow to dry prior to general application. If moisture is present, allow for application of Sikalastic Moisture Seal, refer to PDS for application rates.
Single component, ready to use undiluted, prior to application thoroughly mix using a mechanical mixer to produce a homogenous liquid.
Remove liquid coating immediately with a dry cloth, clean tools and equipment with water while the material is still wet. Cured coating can only be removed mechanically.

layer_thickness.label: Dry film thickness
layer_thickness.text: Minimum 1mm DFT (Dry film thickness) required 2x coats of 1 Litre per m2 are required to achieve a 1mm DFT

cure_times.label: Curing time
cure_times.text: Sika® Tite BE must be cured for at least 48 hours at 23°C (longer at lower temperatures.)

cure_times.label: Curing time
cure_times.text: Sika® Tite BE must be cured for a minimum 3 days before coming in contact with water or any form of backfill.

cure_times.label: Drying time
cure_times.text: Allow minimum 2 - 4 hours between coats at 23°C. Allow longer in adverse weather conditions

cp.text: Sika® Tite BE is not designed to stop a hydrostatic head of water pressure.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Sika® Tite BE must not be used over damp, wet or contaminated substrates.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Sika® Tite BE must not be applied if it is raining or if rain is imminent.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Sika® Tite BE must not be applied directly over protective coatings.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Sika® Tite BE must not be used as a trafficable, exposed or UV stable coating.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Sika® Tite BE is not compatible with polyurethane or silicone sealants.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: In backfilling applications (planter boxes/retaining walls etc) allow a minimum of 3 days cure and use suitable protection layer prior to backfilling.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

cp.text: Do not apply where the substrate temperature is below 10°C or greater than 35°C.
cp.heading: LIMITATIONS

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

storage.label: Materials to avoid
storage.text: No special restrictions on storage with other products.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: For personal protection see section 8. No special handling advice required. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
